title: Practice example: ReciPal
tagline: Snap your fridge, get dinner ideas
theme: students who waste food and order takeout because they don't know what to cook
description: An app that identifies the ingredients in a photo of your fridge and suggests recipes you can make right now, filtered by diet.

title: Practice example: SafeWalk
tagline: A friend watches over you on the walk home
theme: people who feel unsafe walking home alone at night
description: A live-location app that lets a friend follow your route, and alerts them if you stop for too long or leave the path.

title: Practice example: FoodBridge
tagline: Connect leftover restaurant food with food banks
theme: restaurants that throw away good food while food banks struggle to collect it in time
description: A tool that lets a restaurant post leftovers and notifies nearby volunteers who can pick them up before closing.

title: Practice example: StudySpot
tagline: Find a quiet seat on campus right now
theme: students who can't find a quiet place to study during exam week
description: Crowd-sourced seat availability for libraries and study rooms, with noise level reports updated by students.

title: Practice example: LinguaLoop
tagline: Practice a new language by talking to a friendly bot
theme: people learning a second language who are too shy to practice speaking
description: A voice chat partner that adapts to your level, corrects gently, and tracks the words you keep missing.

title: Practice example: BudgetBuddy
tagline: Split bills and track shared costs without awkwardness
theme: roommates who argue about who owes what
description: A shared ledger that scans receipts, splits costs fairly, and sends friendly reminders.

title: Practice example: GreenCommute
tagline: Make biking and transit the easy choice
theme: commuters who drive alone because greener options feel confusing
description: Combines bike lanes, bus times and weather into one suggestion, and rewards low-carbon trips.

title: Practice example: SignSpeak
tagline: Learn basic sign language from your webcam
theme: people who want to communicate with deaf friends or classmates but have nowhere to practice
description: Uses the camera to recognise hand shapes and gives instant feedback while you practice common signs.
